text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, a message arrives from the 
Goddesses Three. It is an invitation to 
the "WBC," held at the end of the year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the Classic Year, <chrname>'s potential was once 
again recognized by the Three Goddesses. 
As her Trainer, I felt a genuine sense of 
joy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, despite her own Umamusume being 
selected for the WBC, Trainer Kashimoto 
wore a gloomy expression.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even when running the way she excelled at 
most, Bitter Glace stood absolutely no 
chance in the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Around this time, Umamusume begin to amass 
ample strength and experience. For her, 
having relied solely on her physical 
prowess, a time of trial had arrived.
